title: Relationship Between Two-Species Condensates
exact_target: When both species condense in a two-species zero-range process, determine rigorously how their condensates are related.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000226 (OWR-827-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mini-Workshop: Particle Systems with Several Conservation Laws: Fluctuations and Hydrodynamic Limit (2005), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2005/22, pp. 1199--1230; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF page 21, printed page 1219.
Grosskinsky, two-species zero-range invariant measures; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The source proves ensemble and single-site condensation facts under assumptions on its weights. The remaining relation of two condensates includes their locations and coupled mass fluctuations; the brief source does not prescribe one particular statistic or a universal rate function.
